Case ID: 1133
Case Type: HR Request
Date: 2025-03-30
Handled By: HR - Rina Flores
Customer or Requestor: Internal Employee - Daniel Kim
Title: Performance review reconsideration request

Issue Description
Employee requested HR review of an annual performance rating, stating that a major process-improvement project was not considered in the manager's written assessment.

Steps Taken
- Reviewed the submitted reconsideration request and supporting project documentation.
- Met separately with the employee, manager, and next-level leader to understand the omitted evidence.
- Checked calibration notes to confirm whether the project contribution had been discussed during rating alignment.
- Compared the review narrative with documented business outcomes and team metrics.

Resolution
HR determined the review required factual correction, updated the written assessment to include the project impact, and adjusted the development plan language while leaving the overall rating unchanged.

Follow-Up
Managers in the department were reminded to reference documented evidence consistently in future reviews.

Reference Documents
- Performance Management Policy 2025
